subject: planning
what: The city's own Planning Department record of what was proposed on this block, and what the department decided about it. NOT the Board of Supervisors deciding.

units.n: planning projects opened on this block since 2000
units.y0: earliest open_date year on the block
units.y1: latest open_date year on the block
units.un: number_of_units_net summed over the block's projects and rounded — homes the applications propose to ADD or REMOVE, as applied for. Not a count of homes built.

not_measured: Whether a proposed project was BUILT. This file carries what was applied for and what the department decided, never completion.
Projects the department records without a block (see coverage). They are dropped, never attributed to a neighbouring block.
Anything the Board of Supervisors decided after 1999. That record is in Legistar, carries no location, and is not in this file.
